observations: A warm amber-yellow field fills most of the background, layered with dark brushed shapes and crossed by loose scribbled lines in white, red, teal, and purple across the full surface.

Four distinct face-like forms are distributed across the composition: upper-left in black with yellow circular eyes and bared teeth, center with teal spiral eyes and an open red mouth, right-center with blue rectangular eyes and a jagged red mouth, and lower-right a black animal-like head with teal markings.
A solid black rounded figure occupies the lower-left corner with a red coil and teal curl at its base, while a thin stick-like silhouette appears partially cropped at the upper-right edge.
reading: Four open-mouthed forms crowd the amber field, each built from looping spirals and jagged tooth lines that read as alarm or display rather than calm. The warm ground pushes forward while black figures anchor the edges. White lines move freely across all of them, refusing to settle into any single form, giving the whole surface a feeling of unresolved noise.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #182 and nnxyz nnotb #184 share the multi-figure, open-mouth format but shift ground color — #182 to deep red, #184 to cooler grey-blue — making #183's amber field a distinct warm episode in the run.

connections.reason: nnxyz nnotb #182 uses the same crowded multi-figure layout and spiral-eye motif, but its dominant red-black ground makes the amber warmth of #183 a direct tonal contrast between title neighbors in the owned subset.

Scrimshaw 41 isolates a single face built from the same vocabulary — spiral eyes, rectangular tooth-lined mouth, loose colored lines over a warm amber-gold ground — that the collector links across the two artists by shared visual qualities.

lookingQuestion: Which of the four face-like forms do the free-floating white lines seem to pass through most, and does that change how you read its relationship to the others?
ambiguities: The upper-right stick-like silhouette is partially cropped and its form is ambiguous — it may be a limb, a separate figure, or a loose mark.
nnxyz nnotb #184 was inspected but its cooler, single-figure close-up format offers contrast rather than a strong formal parallel, so it was not selected as a connection.
